label: STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_1: the betterness ranking read as value
term: standard of favouring, value sense (ValueStandard good)
definition: ValueStandard good is the supplied ranking good of candidates in each variation scenario, read as value: good s x y says that x is a better good than y at s. It is a declared primitive: Lean does not type value, and the declaration only marks the sense of the parameter. Examples: a candidate arrangement that benefits its recipients more than another ranks above it. Non-examples: lower action of a path, greater weight, realizing a given end content D (each may coincide with value at a scenario without being it). Nothing in the record says that value factors through end-realization or that it varies within an end-realization class; the latter is the open premise BetternessVariesWithinEndClass.
